expectations.evidence: api-http.service.ts handleError() checks error.status === 0 for network errors vs numeric status codes for backend errors, typed as HttpErrorResponse
handleError() calls this.router.navigate(['/login']) on status 401 with a session-expired toast
retry.interceptor.ts uses retry({ count: MAX_RETRIES, delay }) with exponential backoff (2^retryCount * 1000 ms), only retries on status 503
global-error-handler.ts: @Injectable() present (no providedIn), class implements ErrorHandler
app.config.ts: provideBrowserGlobalErrorListeners() is the first provider in the array
retry.interceptor.ts exports retryInterceptor as HttpInterceptorFn — functional, not class-based
All services use inject() for DI (e.g., inject(HttpClient), inject(ToastService), inject(Router))
api-http.service.spec.ts and retry.interceptor.spec.ts both use provideHttpClient() followed by provideHttpClientTesting() and HttpTestingController
